def main():

    operations = [sys.stdin.readline().strip() for _ in range(q)]
    history = []
    current = defaultdict(int)
    current_priorities = []
    current_assignments = set()

        parts = operations[day].split()
        op = parts[0]

            ai, xi = parts[1], int(parts[2])

                current_priorities.remove(old_priority)
